actions.action: Measure pH and PPM/EC of runoff or input water
Hand test at canopy level and raise or dim the light if hot
Check light distance against manufacturer recommendation
Check pot weight and soil moisture; wait longer between waterings if damp
Water when top 1-2 inches are dry until 10-20% runoff
If pH is off, correct it gently
Add a Cal-Mag supplement after checking pH
Watch new growth over the next week
Reply with medium, light, feeding schedule, pH, plant age/stage, and where yellowing started
